title: Codex capability preflight ignores AGENTS.md, so repository-mandated plugins are never provisioned and the model's request_plugin_install is rejected
body:
## Summary

The Codex capability preflight only reads the **GitHub issue title, body and comments**. It never reads the target repository's `AGENTS.md`. When a repository declares its mandatory plugin workflow in `AGENTS.md` — which is exactly where an agent-facing repository is supposed to declare it — the preflight detects **zero** requirements, returns early, and `codex exec` starts against an unprovisioned home.

The model then correctly reads `AGENTS.md` itself, tries to self-install the plugin through the only affordance Codex offers it (`request_plugin_install`), and is rejected by the ChatGPT backend allowlist:

```text
plugin_id must match one of the entries in the <recommended_plugins> list
```

The run then stops without touching the worktree, exactly as `AGENTS.md` instructs. Two full solver sessions were burned this way on 2026-07-23 (~$0.31), producing no work.

This is **not** a regression of #2094 — that fix shipped in v2.8.11 and the failing run *was* v2.8.11. It is a gap that #2074, #2077, #2080, #2084, #2088 and #2094 all left open, because every one of them tuned what happens *after* a requirement is detected. Here nothing is ever detected, so the entire repaired pipeline is skipped.

- Failing PR: https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/pull/6
- Source issue: https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/issues/5
- Full logs: [run 1](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/d0aa3b8e7f88754eda1911bc23abce79/raw/872ef3c96419f704c26961c959659a8d519be80c/tmp-solution-draft-log-pr-1784809014365.txt.log.txt) · [run 2](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/konard/97b17fade9dbc52ea088cbc047175de4/raw/bb560370e514483f67ad9ef93a7d57c4898c149d/tmp-solution-draft-log-pr-1784812579100.txt.log.txt)
- Repo owner's diagnosis: ["you need to install superpowers plugin before start"](https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/pull/6#issuecomment-5058690204)

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Hive Mind | `solve v2.8.11` (contains the #2094 fix, released 2026-07-22) |
| Codex CLI | `0.145.0` (per the run's telemetry `app.version`) |
| Model | `gpt-5.6-sol`, thinking off |
| Auth | `auth_mode="Chatgpt"`, `originator=codex_exec` |
| Target | `CEHR2005/GCS-TS#5` → PR #6, fork mode |

## Root cause 1 (primary, ours): requirement discovery never reads `AGENTS.md`

`src/codex-capability-preflight.lib.mjs:319-325` defines the entire requirement corpus:

```js
const readIssueRequirementText = async ({ owner, repo, issueNumber, runCommand, env }) => {
  const issueResult = await runCommand({ command: 'gh', args: ['api', `repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${issueNumber}`], env });
  const issue = parseJsonCommand(issueResult, 'Codex capability issue discovery');
  const commentsResult = await runCommand({ command: 'gh', args: ['api', `repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${issueNumber}/comments`, '--paginate'], env });
  const comments = parseJsonCommand(commentsResult, 'Codex capability comment discovery');
  return [issue?.title, issue?.body, ...(Array.isArray(comments) ? comments.map(comment => comment?.body) : [])].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
};
```

Issue #5's body is a pure engineering spec — trait bonus calculation, acceptance criteria, a Docker gate. The word "superpowers" does not appear in it, nor in any comment at solve time. The requirement lives **only** in [`CEHR2005/GCS-TS/AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/blob/main/AGENTS.md):

```markdown
## Mandatory Superpowers implementation workflow

- Before inspecting implementation details or changing files for an implementation issue,
  invoke `superpowers:using-superpowers` from `plugin://superpowers@openai-curated-remote`.
- If the official Superpowers capability is absent, attempt to install the exact plugin
  `superpowers@openai-curated-remote` through the environment-supported plugin installation workflow.
- If installation or skill invocation fails, stop before implementation, keep the worktree clean,
  and report the exact error and attempted steps. No manual workflow fallback is authorized.
```

So `provisionCodexCapabilities` hits the early return at line 600:

```js
if (requirements.plugins.length === 0 && requirements.skills.length === 0) return { required: false, plugins: [], codexHome: null };
```

**Confirmed by log absence.** The failing run emits no `🔌 Codex capability preflight`, no `🧭 Scoped Codex loader`, no `Model-visible skills`, no `plugin add` — the preflight's entire log surface is silent. Compare the #2088/#2094 logs, which are full of these lines. `grep -c "capability preflight" run2.log` → `0`.

**The detector itself is fine.** Running the shipped detector against the `AGENTS.md` text resolves it perfectly:

```console
$ node -e "import('./src/codex-capability-preflight.lib.mjs').then(m =>
    console.log(m.detectRequiredCodexCapabilities(AGENTS_MD_TEXT)))"
{
  plugins: [ 'superpowers@openai-curated' ],
  skills:  [ 'superpowers:using-superpowers' ],
  explicit:[ 'superpowers:using-superpowers', 'superpowers@openai-curated' ],
  rejected: []
}
```

Both requirements are detected, both marked `explicit` (so they would fail closed per #2088), and the marketplace is normalized to the installable spelling. **The machinery works — it is simply never handed the text.** This is a one-input fix, not a redesign.

## Root cause 2 (upstream, OpenAI): `request_plugin_install` cannot install anything under `codex exec`

Because our preflight provisioned nothing, the model fell back to Codex's own affordance. From the run log (line 826):

```text
event.name="codex.tool_result" tool_name=request_plugin_install
  arguments={"plugin_id":"superpowers@openai-curated-remote", "suggest_reason":"Плагин обязателен по AGENTS.md…"}
  duration_ms=0 success=false
  output=plugin_id must match one of the entries in the <recommended_plugins> list
  auth_mode="Chatgpt" originator=codex_exec app.version=0.145.0 model=gpt-5.6-sol
ERROR codex_core::tools::router: error=plugin_id must match one of the entries in the <recommended_plugins> list
```

Verified against codex `rust-v0.145.0` (commit `25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0`):

1. **The allowlist is server-driven and cannot be extended locally.** `<recommended_plugins>` is populated from `GET {chatgpt_base_url}/ps/plugins/suggested?scope=GLOBAL` ([`core-plugins/src/remote.rs#L855-L867`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/core-plugins/src/remote.rs#L855-L867)), capped at 50 entries ([`recommended_plugins_instructions.rs`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/core/src/context/recommended_plugins_instructions.rs)). No `config.toml` key adds entries — `tool_suggest.discoverables` is read only on the *legacy* path, and `disabled_tools` can only remove. Our account's suggestion list simply does not include Superpowers.
2. **The comparison is exact string equality** against the in-memory candidate vector, with no normalization ([`request_plugin_install.rs#L150-L179`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/request_plugin_install.rs#L150-L179)).
3. **It never installs — it only asks.** The handler emits an MCP *elicitation* for the host UI. And `codex exec` **auto-cancels every elicitation** ([`exec/src/lib.rs#L1660-L1672`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs#L1660-L1672) — *"Exec auto-cancels elicitation instead of surfacing it interactively"*). **So even if Superpowers were on the allowlist, this call could never have installed it in our headless solver.** Provisioning before `codex exec` is the only path that can ever work.
4. Upstream already acknowledges the rejection in the open PR [openai/codex#31694](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/31694): *"Today `request_plugin_install` rejects those IDs before the user can see the normal install elicitation."* Unmerged as of `rust-v0.145.0`.

**Action:** nothing to wait for upstream. Even a merged #31694 would not help `codex exec`. This section exists so we stop re-investigating the error string.

## Root cause 3 (latent, ours): the two marketplace spellings

`AGENTS.md` names `superpowers@openai-curated-remote`. `normalizePluginSelector` rewrites `@openai-curated-remote` → `@openai-curated` (`codex-capability-preflight.lib.mjs:85-90`). **This normalization is correct and must be kept** — verified on real Codex 0.144.6:

```console
$ codex plugin list --available --json | jq '[.available[].marketplaceName] | unique'
[ "codex-warp", "openai-curated" ]          # 180 entries, no "openai-curated-remote"

$ codex plugin add superpowers@openai-curated-remote
Error: plugin `superpowers` was not found in marketplace `openai-curated-remote`

$ codex plugin list --available --json | jq '.available[] | select(.pluginId|test("superpowers"))'
{ "pluginId": "superpowers@openai-curated", "version": "5.1.3", "installed": false, … }
```

They are genuinely distinct marketplaces upstream: `OPENAI_CURATED_MARKETPLACE_NAME = "openai-curated"` ([`lib.rs#L26`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/core-plugins/src/lib.rs#L26)) is the local marketplace that `plugin add` can install from; `REMOTE_GLOBAL_MARKETPLACE_NAME = "openai-curated-remote"` ([`remote.rs#L69`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/core-plugins/src/remote.rs#L69)) is the synthesized remote namespace, not installable via CLI. `plugin://…` is a *mention* URI for already-installed plugins, unrelated to installation.

The trap: installing into `openai-curated` means the remote catalog's merge deletes it again ([`loader.rs#L208-L258`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/25af12f7e61572b0bc18ddb1008be543b91519b0/codex-rs/core-plugins/src/loader.rs#L208-L258)) — which is precisely why #2094 writes `features.remote_plugin = false` into the scoped home. **That override is only applied inside `configureScopedPluginLoader`, which the early return skipped.** So fixing root cause 1 automatically re-arms #2094's protection. The three defects are one chain.

## Reproduction

1. Take a repo whose `AGENTS.md` mandates a Codex plugin but whose issue text does not mention it (`CEHR2005/GCS-TS#5` is the live case).
2. `solve https://github.com/CEHR2005/GCS-TS/issues/5 --tool codex --model gpt-5.6-sol` with a ChatGPT-authenticated Codex whose account lacks Superpowers in its suggested list.
3. Observe: no `🔌 Codex capability preflight` line; `codex exec` starts; the model calls `request_plugin_install`; `plugin_id must match…`; session ends with a clean worktree and no commits.

Minimal unit-level reproduction (no network), which is the test to write first:

```js
// Fails today: returns { plugins: [], skills: [] } because AGENTS.md is not part of the corpus.
const requirements = await collectCodexCapabilityRequirements({ owner, repo, issueNumber, projectDir });
assert.deepEqual(requirements.plugins, ['superpowers@openai-curated']);
assert.deepEqual(requirements.skills,  ['superpowers:using-superpowers']);
```

## Proposed fix

**1. Extend the requirement corpus to the checked-out repository's agent instruction files.** The checkout already exists at `projectDir` when the preflight runs (`src/codex.lib.mjs:748`), so this needs no extra network call:

- `AGENTS.md` / `agents.md` at repo root, plus nested ones (GCS-TS has a normative `packages/gcs-engine/AGENTS.md`). Bound the walk — root + a depth/count cap — to keep it cheap.
- `CLAUDE.md` for `--tool claude` parity, and `.codex/` instruction files if present.
- Keep issue/comment text as-is; concatenate.

Keep the existing `explicit`/`qualified` gating untouched, so #2077's false-positive protection and #2088's fail-closed semantics carry over unchanged. Note this *widens* the detector's input to prose written for agents, so the `--verbose` `⏭️ Ignored non-capability token` logging matters more than before; #2080's structured-scalar rejection should be re-checked against real `AGENTS.md` files.

**2. Log the negative result.** The single most expensive property of this bug is that a skipped preflight is indistinguishable from a healthy one. When zero requirements are detected, emit at `--verbose`:

```
🔌 Codex capability preflight: no plugin or skill requirements detected (sources: issue #5, 2 comments, AGENTS.md, packages/gcs-engine/AGENTS.md)
```

Naming the *sources scanned* is what turns the next occurrence into a five-second diagnosis.

**3. Teach the solver that `request_plugin_install` is a dead end under `codex exec`.** Since it can never succeed headlessly (auto-cancelled elicitation), detect the `plugin_id must match one of the entries in the <recommended_plugins> list` signature in the Codex event stream and surface it as a named Hive Mind failure pointing at the preflight — rather than letting it surface as an opaque model-authored summary in the target repo's PR.

**4. Optional escape hatch.** `--require-codex-plugin <selector>` / `HIVE_MIND_CODEX_REQUIRED_PLUGINS`, for repositories that state the requirement somewhere we do not parse.

## Requirements checklist

- [ ] Failing regression test committed **before** the fix, asserting `AGENTS.md`-sourced requirements are detected (RED → GREEN evidence recorded)
- [ ] Root + nested `AGENTS.md`/`agents.md` (and `CLAUDE.md`) from `projectDir` feed the detector, with a bounded walk
- [ ] `normalizePluginSelector`'s `-remote` → `openai-curated` rewrite retained, with the CLI evidence above recorded as a comment so it is not "fixed" later
- [ ] #2094's `features.remote_plugin = false` scoped override verified to engage on this path
- [ ] Explicit `AGENTS.md` requirements fail closed per #2088; heuristics stay advisory per #2077
- [ ] Zero-requirement preflight logs the sources it scanned
- [ ] `request_plugin_install` rejection recognized and reported as a Hive Mind diagnostic
- [ ] End-to-end verification against `CEHR2005/GCS-TS#5` showing 14 `superpowers:*` skills visible via `codex debug prompt-input` before `codex exec`
- [ ] Case study under `docs/case-studies/issue-<N>/` with logs, per the #2074→#2094 convention
- [ ] Changeset added

## Why previous attempts did not catch this

| Issue | What it fixed | Why it missed this |
|---|---|---|
| #2074 | Repo-scoped `CODEX_HOME`, provision before `codex exec` | Corpus fixed as issue + comments from day one |
| #2077 | `16:9` false positive | Tuned the detector, not its input |
| #2080 | `additionalProperties:false` false positive | Same |
| #2084 | `plugin list` ≠ model visibility; probe `codex debug prompt-input` | Verification stage, runs only after detection |
| #2088 | Repair ladder + fail-closed | Repair stage, runs only after detection |
| #2094 | `remote_plugin=false` vs the curated loader filter | Loader config, written only after detection |

Every fix improved a stage **downstream** of the early return at line 600. A requirement expressed only in `AGENTS.md` short-circuits all of them. Detection input is the one link in the chain that was never revisited — which is also why the fix is small.
